foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat $135.00 filing fee for the Foreign Business Limited Liability Company Certificate of Authority Application filed online through the FirstStop Portal; the LLC fees page prices registration the same for domestic and foreign LLCs.
foreignQualification.formName: Foreign Business Limited Liability Company Certificate of Authority Application
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File the annual report each year (due November 15 for LLCs) and maintain a North Dakota registered agent with a physical address in the state.

evidence.quote: NDCC ch. 10-32.1 pertains to LLCs. Fees Registration (domestic and foreign) - $135
An out-of-state LLC must obtain a certificate of authority from the Secretary of State to transact business or provide professional services in North Dakota, or to obtain any license or permit.
Foreign Business Limited Liability Company Certificate of Authority Application
Corporations, LLCs, and partnerships (except for general partnerships) must maintain a North Dakota registered agent that has a physical address in North Dakota.
Most businesses in North Dakota must file an annual report with the Office of the Secretary of State to stay in good standing.
November 15 Limited Liability Company (LLC) Professional Limited Liability Company (PLLC)

notes: The Foreign Business Limited Liability Company Certificate of Authority Application is filed online through the Secretary of State's FirstStop Portal (form 283); the portal's form definition states the $135 filing fee and references SFN 19381 as its paper equivalent, whose nd.gov/eforms PDF now returns 404, so the online channel is the common filing path and no paper PDF is cited. Registration is priced the same for domestic and foreign LLCs ($135), matching root states.json; the LLC annual report is $50, due November 15, also matching root. The form title and fee are quoted from the FirstStop portal's form-definition API JSON, which is the portal's own published data endpoint.
